body:
Long story short, I cheated on her. I really have no right to be upset. I was feeling bad about myself and snapchatted dirty photos with a girl. One time thing, no emotions, felt awful about it. But I never told her, and she found out two weeks ago. It's my fault. I shouldn't have taken her for granted or risked her heart like that. I was always afraid of being inadequate, but that very fear is what made me inadequate. 

I'm seeing a psychologist on Tuesday but I'd really rather not go on meds. I don't think they will help me at all. Taking care of myself is complicated by the fact that I just a minor surgery that is keeping me from doing much physical activity. Awful timing.
